api.base_url: https://quickbooks.api.intuit.com/v3/company/{realmId} (host from Nango providers.yaml; /v3/company path UNVERIFIED on fetched page)

auth.refresh: Refresh token valid up to 100 days, but value rotates every 24-26 hours; always store newest

access_requirements.partner_program_name: Intuit Developer program (free account); production keys require completing app assessment questionnaire
access_requirements.app_review_or_marketplace_listing: Production credentials need app details/privacy/EULA and security questionnaire; Intuit App Store listing optional (UNVERIFIED fetched page)
access_requirements.customer_admin_must_do: Company admin clicks Connect to QuickBooks and approves the consent screen selecting the company; no other setup.
access_requirements.cost_to_us: Free to build; Intuit announced tiered API/CorePlus pricing - UNVERIFIED

sandbox.how_to_get: Free sandbox companies from Intuit developer account (quickbooks-sandbox provider host)

rate_limits: 500 requests/minute per realm ID, 10 concurrent requests per second per realm and app, 40 batch requests/minute per realm (help.developer.intuit.com API call limits and throttling, via search snippet)

events: Account (entity create/update/delete notifications; full list UNVERIFIED)

incremental_sync: Change Data Capture endpoint (/cdc?entities=...&changedSince=) or query WHERE MetaData.LastUpdatedTime > cursor; CDC page itself UNVERIFIED (fetch failed)

unified_api_coverage.merge_dev: yes (QuickBooks Online appears in merge.dev/integrations HTML)

blockers: Refresh-token rotation must be persisted atomically or connection dies
Production app assessment before connecting real customers
sources: https://help.developer.intuit.com/s/article/Validity-of-Refresh-Token - refresh token up to 100 days (via search)
